name: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Plc
source: Multi-Trex Integrated Foods Plc annual report, results at a glance (NGX filing library)

rows.label: Total Liabilities
rows.derivedFrom: Total Liabilities = Total Assets - Total Equity (the report page prints no liabilities split)

source_note: Naira thousands. The report carries these totals on its results at a glance page: total assets, shareholders fund (carried as total equity) and the component lines share capital, deposit for shares, property plant and equipment and revaluation reserve. The report prints no current and non-current split, so those rows are withheld and Total Liabilities is arithmetic on the two printed totals, tagged derived. Assets equal liabilities plus equity in both years to the unit.

derivation.note: rows tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures, not printed in the source
